name: officedev-microsoft-teams-samples-bot-attachments-dotnet
title: Agent Attachments
shortDescription: This sample demonstrates how to receive file attachments in Microsoft Teams, request consent, and upload to OneDrive using the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK.
longDescription: This sample demonstrates file attachment handling using the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK and its Teams extension. When a user sends a file, the agent downloads it, sends a File Consent Card requesting permission to upload to OneDrive, and queues the upload for processing. A hosted background service performs the upload asynchronously and proactively sends the result to the user without retaining the incoming turn context. Declined requests are handled gracefully with a notification message.
